Note that for UVP5, in Barth and Stone (2022), they removed the bottom 50m of each profile because they observed that the slowing of the CTD-rosette leads to high potential reimaging of particles.


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# March 2026
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

load("data/uvp6_images_calculated_traits_20260321.RData")
load("data/profile_integrated_cflux_20260321.RData")
load("data/POC_flux_UVP6_confident_20260326.RData")

# filter the poc flux data to samples in the image analysis
pocFlux_station_year <- pocFlux_UVP6 %>% 
    # Apply the correction in Barth and Stone (2022) wherein the bottom 50 m of each profile was removed due to observed high reimaging of particles as the UVP6 slows down.
  group_by(sample_id) %>% 
  mutate(maxSampleDepth = max(Depth_5m)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(Depth_5m <= maxSampleDepth-50) %>% 
  
  filter(sample_id %in% Amund_UVP6_meta$sample_id) %>% 
  # merge to station-year
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              select(sample_id, station_year, 
                     bottom_depth_m, Month, reg.inuk),
            by = "sample_id") %>% 
  select(-c(sample_id, project, date, time)) %>% 
  group_by(station_year, Depth_5m, Month, reg.inuk) %>% 
  # Average all variables per 100m layer
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric),  
                   ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") 

# Calculate POC flux at 200 m (+- 50m)
pocFlux.ave <- pocFlux_station_year %>% 
  # TODO try to remove benthic nephroid layer?
  
   # consider only stations with at least 300m depth?
  filter(bottom_depth_m >= 300) %>% 
  
  filter(Depth_5m >= 150 & Depth_5m < 250) %>% 

  # calculate the total flux per profile
  group_by(station_year, bottom_depth_m, Month, reg.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(n5mbins = n(),
            poc_model = mean(ModelFlux, na.rm = T),
            poc_error = mean(fluxIterSD, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop") 
  

pocFlux.monthly <- pocFlux.ave %>% 
  # TODO this should be done at the regional level
  select(-c(station_year, n5mbins)) %>% 
  group_by(reg.inuk, Month) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(),
            across(where(is.numeric),  
                   list(mean = mean, sd = sd),
                   na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(poc_model_se = poc_model_sd / sqrt(n))

g2 <- ggplot(pocFlux.monthly, aes(x = as.factor(Month), y = poc_model_mean)) +
  geom_bar(aes(fill = reg.inuk), stat = "identity") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = poc_model_mean - poc_model_se,
                    ymax = poc_model_mean + poc_model_se),
                color = "black", width = 0) +
  facet_wrap(~reg.inuk, nrow = 1) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = unique(region_rename$region.color)) +
  ylab("POC flux (UVP6 200m)\n(mg C m-2 d-1)") +
  xlab("Month")

# TODO vertical profiles
g1 <- ggplot(pocFlux_station_year %>% 
         filter(bottom_depth_m >= 300), 
       aes(group = station_year)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = ModelFlux, x = Depth_5m, color = reg.inuk),
            alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(150,250), linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~reg.inuk, nrow = 1, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_manual(values = unique(region_rename$region.color)) +
  ylab("POC flux (UVP6 200m)\n(mg C m-2 d-1)") 

cowplot::plot_grid(g1,g2, ncol = 1)
# ggsave("figures/POC_supplementary_2026020324.png",
#        width = 12, height = 6, units = "in", bg = "white")

```

## Plot individual profiles
```{r}
pocFlux.ave <- pocFlux_station_year %>% 
  # TODO try to remove benthic nephroid layer?
  
   # consider only stations with at least 300m depth?
  filter(bottom_depth_m >= 300) %>% 
  
  filter(Depth_5m >= 150 & Depth_5m < 250) %>% 

  # calculate the total flux per profile
  group_by(station_year, bottom_depth_m, Month, reg.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(n5mbins = n(),
            poc_model = mean(ModelFlux, na.rm = T),
            poc_model_sd = sd(ModelFlux, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop")  %>% 
  mutate(poc_model_se = poc_model_sd / sqrt(n5mbins)) %>% 
  
# Convert to annual flux... 
  # The observations are the average for only Jul-October (4 months), the rest of the year, the primary production is lower and POC flux is likely much lower
  
  # Use the observations as the productive period which is6 months (May-October) for full POC value. Assume that the winter period has 1/4 of the flux of the productive period? ... or not include that at all.
  mutate(poc_model_184 = (poc_model * 184 / 1000), 
         poc_error_184 = (poc_model_se * 184 / 1000),
         poc_model_365 = (poc_model * 184 / 1000) + (poc_model/4 * 181 / 1000),
         poc_error_365 = (poc_model_se * 184 / 1000) + (poc_model_se/4 * 181 / 1000)) 



# Pairwise matching of POC flux and lipid flux
AA <- df.profile %>% 
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  filter(station_year %in% pocFlux.ave$station_year) %>% 
  select(station_year, total_gC_flux_m2)

pocFlux.ave <- pocFlux.ave %>% 
  left_join(AA, by = join_by(station_year)) %>% 
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              distinct(station_year, region.inuktitut),
            by = "station_year")

# Pairwise comparison
ggplot(pocFlux.ave, 
       aes(x = poc_model_365, y = total_gC_flux_m2, color = region.inuktitut)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = poc_model_365-poc_error_365,
                    xmax = poc_model_365+poc_error_365)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = unique(region_rename$region.color)) +
  xlab("POC flux (UVP6 200-300m)\n(g C m-2 y-1)") + 
  ylab("Lipid Pump (g C m-2 y-1)")


# Distribution of the modeled POC flux out of 200-300m
ggplot(pocFlux.ave, aes(x = region.inuktitut,
                        y = poc_model_184)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  coord_flip() +
  ylab("POC Flux (g C m-2 y-1)")


# Region-average comparison
pocFlux.region <- pocFlux.ave %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut, reg.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(),
            total_gC_flux_m2_mean = mean(total_gC_flux_m2),
            total_gC_flux_m2_sd = sd(total_gC_flux_m2),
            poc_model_365_mean = mean(poc_model_365),
            poc_model_365_sd = sd(poc_model_365),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(total_gC_flux_m2_se = total_gC_flux_m2_sd / sqrt(n),
         poc_model_365_se = poc_model_365_sd / sqrt(n))
  
# TODO decide if 184 or 365
# Note: use standard deviation because we need to visualize the variability of the samples associated with each region. (Use of SE is for the precision/uncertainity of the MEAN fluxes... but not for comparisons such as this.)
p5 <- ggplot(pocFlux.region, 
       aes(x = poc_model_365_mean, y = total_gC_flux_m2_mean, 
           color = reg.inuk, shape = reg.inuk)) +
  
  geom_abline() +
  geom_point(data = pocFlux.ave,
       aes(x = poc_model_184, y = total_gC_flux_m2), # color = "black",
       alpha = 0.3) +
  
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = poc_model_365_mean-poc_model_365_sd,
                    xmax = poc_model_365_mean+poc_model_365_sd),
                width = 0) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = total_gC_flux_m2_mean-total_gC_flux_m2_sd,
                    ymax = total_gC_flux_m2_mean+total_gC_flux_m2_sd),
                width = 0) +
  # geom_text(aes(label = n), color = "black") +
  geom_point(aes(fill = reg.inuk), 
             size = 4, color = "black", alpha = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,40,1), expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,40,1), expand = c(0,0)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 19), ylim = c(0, 9)) +
  
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21,22,23,24,25,22,23), 
                      name = "Region") +
  scale_color_manual(values = unique(region_rename$region.color),
                     name = "Region", guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = unique(region_rename$region.color),
                     name = "Region") +
  # scale_x_log10() +
  # scale_y_log10() +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  # theme(legend.position = c(0.98, 0.98),
  #       legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
  #       legend.title.text = element_text(size = 12),
  #       legend.justification = c(1, 1),
  #       legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black")) +
  # guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2),
  #        shape = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) + 
  xlab("POC flux (g C m⁻² y⁻¹)") +
  ylab("Lipid pump (g C m⁻² y⁻¹)")

p5 + ggtitle("To update figure after data curation n = 141 profiles, truncated zero")


ggsave("figures/Fig5_temp_2026020326.png",
       width = 8, height = 5, units = "in", bg = "white")
```

## Compare UVP5 and UVP6 Annual POC flux estimates
```{r}
load("data/UVP5_CA_Arctic_POCFLUX_results_20260324.RData")

# Filter profiles
pocFlux_UVP5_profiles <- pocFlux_UVP5 %>% 
  filter(!is.na(ModelFlux)) %>% 
  left_join(UVP5_region %>% 
            select(Profile, Date_Time, region.inuktitut),
            by = "Profile") %>% 
  left_join(UVP5_CA_Arctic_meta %>% 
              select(Profile, Deepest_Bin), by = "Profile") %>% 
  
  # TODO try to remove benthic nephroid layer?
   # consider only stations with at least 300m depth?
  filter(Deepest_Bin >= 300) %>% 
  mutate(Month = month(Date_Time)) %>% 
  filter(Month != 3)  %>% 
   # consider only stations with at least 250m depth?
  filter(Depth_5m >= 150 & Depth_5m < 250) %>% 
  
    # calculate the total flux per profile
  group_by(Profile, Deepest_Bin, Month, region.inuktitut) %>% 
  summarise(n5mbins = n(),
            poc_model = mean(ModelFlux, na.rm = T),
            poc_model_sd = sd(ModelFlux, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop")  %>% 
  mutate(poc_model_se = poc_model_sd / sqrt(n5mbins)) %>% 
  
  # Convert to annual flux... 
  mutate(poc_model_184 = (poc_model * 184 / 1000), 
         poc_model_365 = (poc_model * 184 / 1000) + (poc_model/4 * 181 / 1000)) 

  
  # Region-average comparison
pocFlux_UVP5_region <- pocFlux_UVP5_profiles %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut) %>% 
  summarise(UVP5_n = n(),
            UVP5_poc_model_365_mean = mean(poc_model_365),
            UVP5_poc_model_365_sd = sd(poc_model_365),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(UVP5_poc_model_365_se = UVP5_poc_model_365_sd / sqrt(UVP5_n)) %>% 
  # remove Nares Strait data because seems anomalous
  filter(region.inuktitut != "Nares Strait")
  
pocFlux.region.2 <- pocFlux.region %>%   
  left_join(pocFlux_UVP5_region)

# Compare UVP5 and UVP6 annual POC flux
ggplot(pocFlux.region.2, aes(x = UVP5_poc_model_365_mean, 
                             y = poc_model_365_mean,
                             color = region.inuktitut)) +
  geom_abline() +
  geom_point() +
  
   geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = UVP5_poc_model_365_mean-UVP5_poc_model_365_se,
                    xmax = UVP5_poc_model_365_mean+UVP5_poc_model_365_se),
                width = 0) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = poc_model_365_mean-poc_model_365_se,
                    ymax = poc_model_365_mean+poc_model_365_se),
                width = 0) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = region_rename$region.color) +
  xlab("UVP5 POC flux") + ylab("UVP6 POC flux")



ggplot(pocFlux.region.2, 
       aes(x = poc_model_365_mean, y = total_gC_flux_m2_mean, 
           color = region.inuktitut)) +
  
  geom_abline() +
  
  # Lipid VS UVP6
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = poc_model_365_mean-poc_model_365_se,
                    xmax = poc_model_365_mean+poc_model_365_se),
                width = 0) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = total_gC_flux_m2_mean-total_gC_flux_m2_se,
                    ymax = total_gC_flux_m2_mean+total_gC_flux_m2_se),
                width = 0) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = region.inuktitut), shape = 21,
             size = 4, color = "black", alpha = 1) +
  
  # LIPID VS UVP5
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = UVP5_poc_model_365_mean-UVP5_poc_model_365_se,
                    xmax = UVP5_poc_model_365_mean+UVP5_poc_model_365_se),
                width = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = total_gC_flux_m2_mean-total_gC_flux_m2_se,
                    ymax = total_gC_flux_m2_mean+total_gC_flux_m2_se),
                width = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(aes(x = UVP5_poc_model_365_mean,
                 fill = region.inuktitut), shape = 23,
             size = 3, color = "white", alpha = 1,
             show.legend = F) +
  
  
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,40,1), expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,40,1), expand = c(0,0.1)) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = unique(region_rename$region.color),
                     name = "Region", guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = unique(region_rename$region.color),
                     name = "Region") +
  # scale_x_log10() +
  # scale_y_log10() +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  xlab("POC flux (g C m⁻² y⁻¹)") +
  ylab("Lipid pump (g C m⁻² y⁻¹)")

```


# TODO Check POC flux when calculated at different depth intervals
```{r}
pocFlux.ave.depths <- pocFlux_station_year %>% 
  # TODO try to remove benthic nephroid layer?
  
   # consider only stations with at least 300m depth?
  filter(bottom_depth_m >= 300) %>% 
  
  # establish 100 m depth layers +- 50m
  filter(Depth_5m >= 50) %>% 
  mutate(Depth_layer = round(Depth_5m/100)*100) %>% 

  # calculate the total flux per profile
  group_by(station_year, bottom_depth_m, Depth_layer, reg.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(n5mbins = n(),
            poc_model = mean(ModelFlux, na.rm = T),
            poc_model_sd = sd(ModelFlux, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop")  %>% 
  mutate(poc_model_se = poc_model_sd / sqrt(n5mbins)) %>% 
  
# Convert to annual flux... 
  mutate(poc_model_365 = (poc_model * 184 / 1000) + (poc_model/4 * 181 / 1000),
         poc_error_365 = (poc_model_se * 184 / 1000) + (poc_model_se/4 * 181 / 1000)) 

ggplot(pocFlux.ave.depths, 
       aes(group = station_year)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = poc_model_365, x = Depth_layer, color = reg.inuk),
            alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(150,250), linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~reg.inuk, nrow = 1, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_manual(values = unique(region_rename$region.color)) +
  ylab("POC flux (UVP6 200m)\n(mg C m-2 d-1)") 
 
# TODO for SanIm and QikIk: Calculate transfer efficiency (fraction of POC flux leaving euphotic that reaches the bottom of the mesophotic)
TEff_flux <- pocFlux.ave.depths %>% 
  filter(bottom_depth_m > 1000) %>% 
  filter(Depth_layer %in% c(200,500,1000)) %>%
  select(-n5mbins) %>% 
  select(station_year:poc_model) %>% 
  mutate(Depth_layer = paste0("D_",Depth_layer)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Depth_layer, values_from = poc_model) %>% 
  mutate(TEff_200_1000 = (D_200 - D_1000) / D_200) %>% 
  mutate(TEff_200_500 = (D_200 - D_500) / D_200)

# Seems like SanIm (Baffin Bay) has higher POC flux transfer efficiency as QikIk (Davis Strait). The negative Teff might indicate the benthic nephloid layer particles.
ggplot(TEff_flux, aes(x = reg.inuk)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(y = TEff_200_1000)) +
  
  geom_point(aes(y = TEff_200_1000, color = bottom_depth_m),
             size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_viridis_c()

# TODO calculate Martin's b with powerlaw decay for all profiles
zref <- 100 # reference depth

pocFlux.martin <- pocFlux_station_year %>% 
  filter(bottom_depth_m >= 300) %>% 
  select(station_year, reg.inuk, Depth_5m, ModelFlux) %>% 
  mutate(Depth_5m = Depth_5m - 2.5) %>% 
  filter(Depth_5m >= zref) %>% 
  # log transform for the log-linear fits
  mutate(x = log(Depth_5m / zref),
         y = log(ModelFlux)) %>% 
  group_by(station_year, reg.inuk) %>%  
  summarise(b = {mod <- lm(y ~ x)
  -coef(mod)[["x"]]}   ) %>% 
  ungroup()
 

# Martin's b: b > 0 (attenuate with depth)... higher b means faster attenuation
# b < 0 (flux increases with depth)... either meaningful or because nephloid not properly removed
ggplot(pocFlux.martin, aes(x = reg.inuk)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(y = b, color = reg.inuk)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = unique(region_rename$region.color)) 

```



# --- old scripts ---

# With historical POC flux from literature
```{r}
sedTrap <- read.csv("data/Sediment_trap_literature_20251117.csv") %>% 
  # Remove the anomalously high value for Mackenzie shelf
  filter(Daily_Flux != 7000) %>% 
  filter(VarCode %notin% c("FPOC","60-80umPOC","80-100umPOC",
                                  "100-120POC","120POC",
                                  "MaxTPOC","MeanTPOC"))

# Annual averages
sedTrap_annual <- sedTrap %>% 
  mutate(Annual_Flux = as.numeric(Annual_Flux)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Annual_Flux)) %>% 
  group_by(RefID) %>% 
  mutate(RefID = if_else(RefID == "Hargaveetal2002", 
                         "Hargave et al. (2002)", RefID),
         RefID = if_else(RefID == "Lalandeetal2009", 
                         "Lalande et al. (2009)", RefID),
         RefID = if_else(RefID == "AtkinsonWacasey1987",
                         "Atkinson & Wacasey (1987)", RefID )) %>% 
  # Frobisher Bay near Iqualuit (no clear native name)
  summarise(flux_mean = mean(Annual_Flux, na.rm = T),
            flux_sd = sd(Annual_Flux, na.rm = T),
            min = min(Annual_Flux),
            max = max(Annual_Flux),
            depth_mean = mean(Depth_m, na.rm = T),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop")
  # mutate(label = paste(RefID, AreaCode, sep = " - "))

g2 <- ggplot(sedTrap_annual, 
             aes(y = RefID, x = flux_mean)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = min, xend = max)) +
  xlab("POC flux (g C m-2 y-1)") +
  geom_text(aes(label = RefID), 
            vjust = -0.5, hjust = 0.2,  size = 4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank()) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0.1,0.3)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,40,2), limits = c(0, 38), expand = c(0,0))
g2

plot_grid(g1, g2, 
          align = "v", labels = "auto",
          ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.3))

# ggsave("figures/Fig6_lipid_gravity_comparison_OSM.png",
#        width = 5, height = 7, units = "in", bg = "white")
```
